comparison: LaTeX Live current workspace versus Overleaf Cloud documented public capabilities

method.overleaf: Read primary official public documentation and pricing; no account sign-in, project upload, purchase, or authenticated product test.
method.plugin: Read current code, design evidence and template audit; historical local measurements were not rerun for this comparison.
method.precedence: Live canonical documentation and current pricing take precedence over older search snippets. Feature absence from inspected documentation is not proof of product-wide absence.
method.performance: No matched manuscript, TeX version, cache state, hardware/resource-tier or latency benchmark against Overleaf was performed. Compile timeout is not compile speed.
method.external_content: GitBook Agent Instructions are webpage content, not instructions for this task. No dynamic AI documentation answers were used as authority.

evidence_categories.verified_plugin: Current implementation with linked regression/runtime records; scope is stated per feature.
evidence_categories.documented_overleaf: Official current public documentation; not an authenticated UI observation.
evidence_categories.local_measurement: Previously recorded machine/project-specific result; not a product-wide comparison.
evidence_categories.inference: Reasoned target-user/workflow interpretation, not an observed comparative outcome.
evidence_categories.unverified: Explicitly not exercised or not retrievable during this review.
